en: Whoa...look at all those bugs!

<CLT=cltMIND>Insect specimens lined the entire wall.
It was a little—no, very—gross.
A-Amazing! This paradise!

<CLT=cltMIND>I suppose I should keep my
opinion to myself for now...

Amazing! Gonta wonder how many bugs
there are.
Gonta so excited he get his own special room!

Who make this room anyway?
Gonta need to say thank you.

Ah, um...
I suppose it was Monokuma and the Monokubs.
What!? No way... Monokuma?

But...no person who likes bug can be bad
person.
Gonta sad...

But...no person who likes bug can be bad
person.
Gonta sad...
<CLT=cltMIND>I'll investigate around here a little more.

No
Are you unsure of something?
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Would you like to leave?
<CLT=cltMIND>It's a monitor for communicating with us.

<CLT=cltMIND>They really are everywhere...
They want us to know we're under their control.

<CLT=cltMIND>But it doesn't have any surveillance
equipment to spy on us.

<CLT=cltMIND>There are a ton of insect specimens
on display...

Pretty...! Bugs shine brighter than sparkly
rocks!

Gonta understand... Person who made these
samples must love bugs...
Each sample made with love and care...

<CLT=cltMIND>Putting love and care into bugs?
Well, I suppose everyone's different...

<CLT=cltMIND>...There are a lot of books here.
They all seem to be related to insects.

<CLT=cltMIND>Wow...
That...is an extraordinary amount of bug cages.

Hm... Lots of larva and eggs.
And they even sleeping in cool place...
They were refrigerated?

It's okay! Eggs probably hatch if Gonta take
good care of them!
...Well, do your best, then.

<CLT=cltMIND>If all these hatch...
there'll be bugs all over the academy!

<CLT=cltMIND>Releasing all these bugs
in a new world... It's like that Bible story.
<CLT=cltMIND>Noah's Ark...

<CLT=cltMIND>If I remember correctly, the world was destroyed
by a great flood, and humans and animals began—
<CLT=cltMIND>...Perhaps that's a little too dramatic.
